_note: Tech ages in order. The run starts in the first; raising a building with ages_up (the Bronze moot) moves the town into the next. Buildings, map nodes, item bases and tool sets with an age only appear once the town has reached it. tools = group upgrades bought with goods while building (one each per run): gather_mult speeds gathering, carry adds to what a gatherer brings back, build_rate adds to craftsperson work speed, attack/hp add to each member's stats, metal means their hits pierce bronze shields. trader = a caravan that visits during the build phase once its building stands; each good has a price in shells and how many it brings each round.

bronze_picks.name: Bronze picks and sickles
bronze_picks.text: Tribespeople gather 50% faster and carry 1 more.

bronze_spears.name: Bronze spears and shields
bronze_spears.text: Warriors hit 3 harder, have 12 more HP, and pierce bronze shields.

trader.name: Southern caravan
trader.text: Traders from the south sell tin and a little cassiterite, at a steep markup over what your own people bring in.
